name: Multiplayer
description: Generic's pillars plus networking. Applying a template replaces your tree, so this includes the basics too; add your genre's pillars below Gameplay.

pillars.name: Gameplay
pillars.vision: The core loop, mechanics and rules the player interacts with.

pillars.name: Networking
pillars.vision: Getting players into the same game and keeping it in sync.

pillars.name: Sessions and Matchmaking
pillars.vision: Hosting, finding and joining games, parties and invites.

pillars.name: Replication
pillars.vision: What's synced, how often, and how lag is hidden.

pillars.name: Authority and Anti-cheat
pillars.vision: Who decides what's true, and how cheating is prevented or detected.

pillars.name: Content
pillars.vision: Levels, encounters, items and other authored content.

pillars.name: Art
pillars.vision: The visual style, assets and their budgets.

pillars.name: Audio
pillars.vision: Music, sound effects and how they react to play.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
